title: Refine Details Panel Single-Line Field Overflow Affordance
description: Refine the global compose/sketchpad Details panel overflow behavior for single-line text fields without changing the current layout system. For any value-side field that currently renders as a one-row text control and whose text exceeds the available width, do not keep it as a normal single truncated row with ellipsis at the end. Instead, switch that field into a compact two-row overflow state: keep the truncated text on the first row, add a second empty row inside the same field box, and render the ellipsis vertically stacked and centered in that second row so it is clearly readable as overflow. Apply this generically to all single-line text-style fields in the right-side property inspector, including editable, readOnly, disabled, and similar text-field variants, while preserving the existing PanelSection, TreeSection, TreeItem, TreeRow, TreeContent, property row and value-column layout, widths, alignment, document, and spacing. Do not affect multiline Textarea controls or non-text widgets. This must be a narrow global overflow affordance improvement, not a redesign. Extend the existing tests or stories to cover the shared behavior and make sure validation passes.
summary: Refined collapsed single-line detail fields to switch overflowing input values into a compact two-row state with the ellipsis moved into a centered stacked overflow row, while preserving textarea behavior. Added pure helper coverage for stacked input overflow versus inline textarea ellipsis, and verified the shared UI bundle with passing tests and a successful Storybook build.
